labels.reason: Source values report group-mean urinary excretion percentages for Meropenem, H-4295 and Total on Day 1 and Day 14. These support candidate renal-elimination input availability, with partial support for DRQ20 and DRQ21. Absolute urinary amounts, collection completeness, the definition of Total and a complete administration schedule remain UNRESOLVED. IV is stated without identifying bolus or infusion. The percentages are neither concentrations nor absolute amounts. No plasma exposure or reported CLR is supplied to support DRQ22. Detection limits, censoring definitions and substituted-detection-limit mean flags are NOT_FOUND.

findings.reason: A74 and A76 explicitly associate this repeat-dose table with 120 mg/kg/day IV for 14 days. They do not specify administration times, doses per day, per-administration amounts, or bolus versus infusion and input duration. A daily dose cannot establish these components or link this study to another PK study.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed administration history and input duration for this study; retain the stated daily dose and duration without completing them from another study.

findings.reason: A78–A80 distinguish Meropenem, H-4295 and Total, but this page does not define Total as total 14C or establish its analytical basis. Salt/free-base dose basis and total versus unbound measurement basis are unspecified. Preserve the printed Total percentages of 102 and 103 without reinterpretation.
findings.needed_material: Original assay and table definitions for Total, Meropenem and H-4295, including dose denominator, formulation basis and any relevant total/unbound distinction.

findings.reason: A76 supplies collection timing through 7 h after the day 1 and day 14 doses and a mean of 3 dogs. Body values are percentages of that day's dose, without interval-specific absolute amounts, urine volumes or concentrations. Initial collection start, completeness, missing intervals and individual versus pooled collection handling are not explicit.
findings.needed_material: If Ae is used, obtain source-defined collection start/end boundaries, completeness and collection units, plus reported absolute amounts or compatible urine volumes and concentrations with units.

findings.reason: Meropenem urinary recovery is source-reported as 63.5 on Day 1 and 61.9 on Day 14, in % of that day's dose. This is a candidate reported recovery percentage through the stated collection endpoint; unchanged-drug assay definition, denominator correspondence, completeness and uncertainty remain unresolved. H-4295 and Total cannot substitute for unchanged-meropenem fe.
findings.needed_material: Traceable unchanged-meropenem recovery definition, dose/analyte correspondence, collection scope and completeness, and reported uncertainty; retain these values as unrecalculated, independently unvalidated candidates.

findings.reason: This page provides urinary recovery percentages but no absolute urinary amounts, compatible plasma exposure or reported CLR. No DRQ22 match is established from this item. Missing urine or CLR inputs do not block independent plasma PK preparation.
findings.needed_material: Only if CLR is selected, obtain compatible urinary amounts and plasma exposure over matching intervals, or a traceable reported CLR with definition, method and uncertainty.
